home.title: RPG Manager
home.pitch: Build your world, create characters and items, and play with your friends straight from the browser. No account, no server: your game lives on your device and players connect directly to the host.
home.screenshotAlt: An RPG Manager character card with its portrait, level, life and mana
home.heading: Your table, in the browser
home.buildText: Attributes, items and characters, shaped to your game.
home.p2pText: Peer to peer, with no account and no server.
home.toolsText: Dice, item generator and character sheet, ready any time.
home.footerTagline: No account, no server: your data stays in your browser.

credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: RPG Manager is built on the work of many open source projects and free tools. Thank you to their authors.
credits.tools: The tools page links to free generators by others: Watabou's Procgen Arcana, Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator and Squoosh. They are not part of this app.
credits.ai: AI was used to write the code and the documentation, and to create the logo and the custom SVG icons. The author would be glad to work with artists to remove the AI "slop" and give the interfaces more life.

contact.intro: A question, a bug or an idea? Send a message.
contact.name: Name
contact.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: RPG Manager has no accounts and no database. This page says what leaves your device.

local.title: What stays on your device
local.text: Your profile, worlds, characters, items and settings are stored in your browser (localStorage and IndexedDB). They are never sent to us. Clearing your browser data erases them.

stun.title: Connecting players (STUN)
stun.text: To connect players directly, your browser asks Google's public STUN server (stun.l.google.com) for its network address. That server therefore sees your IP address.

mailbox.title: Signalling mailbox
mailbox.text: To let a player join from an invite link, the connection codes are held in a small mailbox. They become unavailable after 30 minutes, then are purged.

relay.title: Relay
relay.text: The relay is only used on retry, when a direct connection fails. The app then asks our Netlify Function (/.netlify/functions/ice-servers) for TURN credentials from Open Relay (Metered). The relay sees IP addresses and carries encrypted traffic, not readable content.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.text: The app is hosted on Netlify, which sees the requests made to it (such as your IP address and the pages you load).

contact.title: Contact form
contact.text: Messages sent with the contact form (name, email and message) are received by Web3Forms, which forwards them to us. Do not use it if you do not want this.
